text.title: GraphQL API Design Failure Modes
text.summary: 7 antipatterns observed in real deployments. Each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: createOrder returns Boolean. Six months later the schema has no way to say which field failed validation, and adding one is a breaking change.
antipattern.root-cause: Author took the payload-type shortcut on the first mutation; every later mutation copied it.
antipattern.fix: Add CreateOrderPayload { order, userErrors }. Migrate clients, @deprecate the scalar return, remove it after the grace window. See rules mutation-error-union + user-errors-array.

antipattern.symptom: "Insufficient balance" arrives in the top-level errors[] alongside a nil data field; the client has to parse error strings to tell a business rule from an outage.
antipattern.root-cause: The resolver raised an exception for an expected outcome, so the transport layer reported it.
antipattern.fix: Return the payload with userErrors populated and data null; reserve raised errors for genuinely unexpected failures. See rule user-errors-array.

antipattern.symptom: Each resolver performs its own scope check; an audit finds two resolvers with no check at all.
antipattern.root-cause: No centralised authorization model — the policy lived in whichever resolver the author remembered to edit.
antipattern.fix: Move the policy to an @auth directive in the SDL. Run a coverage script listing every protected field; a reviewer signs off on directive coverage before merge. See rule authorization-via-directives.

antipattern.symptom: Relation author: User resolves against an int id leaked from Postgres; the later migration to UUID breaks every client.
antipattern.root-cause: Storage detail leaked into the schema because the resolver returned the column verbatim.
antipattern.fix: Wrap in a Relay opaque global ID; the server decodes it and the storage type stays invisible. See rule opaque-ids-for-relations.

antipattern.symptom: New Query/Mutation field ships without permission_classes; data silently exposed.
antipattern.root-cause: Author forgot to declare permission; no enforced gate.
antipattern.fix: Add a CI check that requires permission_classes on every Mutation/Query field touching auth-scoped data.

antipattern.symptom: users(offset:0, limit:20) — duplicates and gaps under concurrent writes.
antipattern.root-cause: Author copied REST pagination 1:1 into GraphQL.
antipattern.fix: Convert to Relay cursor pagination (first/after with Connection/Edge/PageInfo).

antipattern.symptom: DataLoader instantiated at module scope; cross-request cache leaks user data.
antipattern.root-cause: Misreading DataLoader README — it is a per-request batching cache, not a global one.
antipattern.fix: Move loader instantiation into get_context(); pin a unit test asserting loaders are created per request.

antipattern.symptom: Nested list resolver triggers one DB query per parent; passes unit tests but quadratic in prod.
antipattern.root-cause: Resolver author did not add DataLoader.
antipattern.fix: Wrap the relation in a DataLoader; assert query count < N+constant in an integration test.
